Read input: autovcoder_031528.v · Open raw
module autovcoder_031528 (
    input  [15:0] x,
    input  [15:0] y,
    output [31:0] p
);

  // Generate abs values
  wire [15:0] x_abs;
  wire [15:0] y_abs;

  // Going for X_abs
  assign x_abs = x ^ {16{x[15]}};


  // Going for Y_abs
  assign y_abs = y ^ {16{y[15]}};


  // LOD x
  wire [15:0] kx;
  wire zero_x;
  wire [3:0] code_x;


  LOD16 LODx (
      .data_i(x_abs),
      .zero_o(zero_x),
      .data_o(kx)
  );


  PriorityEncoder_16 PEx (
      .data_i(kx),
      .code_o(code_x)
  );




  // LOD y

  wire [15:0] ky;
  wire zero_y;
  wire [3:0] code_y;

  LOD16 LODy (
      .data_i(y_abs),
      .zero_o(zero_y),
      .data_o(ky)
  );

  PriorityEncoder_16 PEy (
      .data_i(ky),
      .code_o(code_y)
  );


  // Barell shift X

  wire [ 3:0] code_x_inv;
  wire [15:0] barrel_x;

  assign code_x_inv = ~code_x;

  Barrel16L BShiftx (
      .data_i (x_abs),
      .shift_i(code_x_inv),
      .data_o (barrel_x)
  );


  // Barell shift Y
  wire [ 3:0] code_y_inv;
  wire [15:0] barrel_y;

  assign code_y_inv = ~code_y;

  Barrel16L BShifty (
      .data_i (y_abs),
      .shift_i(code_y_inv),
      .data_o (barrel_y)
  );

  // Addition of Op1 and Op2
  // Here comes the truncation trend [15-1:16-6]
  wire [7:0] op1;
  wire [7:0] op2;
  wire [7:0] L;

  assign op1 = {1'b0, code_x, barrel_x[14:12]};
  assign op2 = {1'b0, code_y, barrel_y[14:12]};

  assign L[7:1] = op1[7:1] + op2[7:1] + 1'b1;

  assign L[0] = 1'b1;

  // Anti logarithm 

  wire [4:0] k_p;
  wire [3:0] m_p;

  assign k_p = L[7:3];
  assign m_p = {1'b1, L[2:0]};


  wire [31:0] tmp_out;
  wire [31:0] tmp1;

  // m_p << k
  Barrel32L Antilog (
      .data_i (m_p),
      .shift_i(k_p),
      .data_o (tmp1)
  );
  // (m_p << k) >> (t-1)
  assign tmp_out = {3'b0, tmp1[31:3]};



  // xor 
  wire prod_sign;
  wire [31:0] tmp_sign;

  assign prod_sign = x[15] ^ y[15];
  assign tmp_sign  = {32{prod_sign}} ^ tmp_out;

  // is zero 
  wire not_zero;
  assign not_zero = (~zero_x | x[15] | x[0]) & (~zero_y | y[15] | y[0]);

  assign p = not_zero ? tmp_sign : 32'b0;

endmodule
